text.p: CS First Boston said it maintained its 'hold' rating on Global Depositary Receipts (GDRs) of Hungarian packaging company Cofinec S.A., saying its first half figures met CSFB's expectations.
"Half-year results are in line with our earlier forecast and we maintain our earnings estimates for the full year," CSFB's analyst Pal Bogar said in a report, dated August 14.
He said the restructuring programme launched by the new management in September last year has a positive impact on Cofinec's operations but added the programme was not agressive enough.
"Further major improvements in profitability are necessary if Cofinec is to become a low-cost, competitive company by Western standards," Bogar said.
